verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Navan has policy limits (e.g., hotel 'price to beat' under policy limit, rideshare policy violation detection, AI comparing spend to policy) implying an underlying policy engine, but there is no documentation of configuring limits by category/role/context or of an auto-approval/exception-routing workflow for expenses. Missing for 10: policy configuration UI/API for role- and context-based limits, evidence of auto-approval for in-policy expenses, and exception escalation workflow to a human approver.
